chunks: He asked him about salat (prayer) on growing grass or on thick greenery while it covers fresh ground. He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.أَرْضًا: ground or earth beneath the vegetation
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act being discussed
key_terms.ٱلنَّابِتِ: growing or sprouting, describing the grass
key_terms.ٱلْحَشِيشِ: grass or herbage serving as the prayer surface

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on growing grass or greenery covering fresh ground?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) on natural ground cover such as growing grass and similar greenery. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in praying on such a surface, indicating its permissibility.
